findings_qualitative.value: High-z quasars show large CIV blueshifts, similar accretion to luminosity-matched low-z quasars, and shallow near zone evolution

evidence.quote: we confirm a shallow evolution of the decreasing quasar near zone sizes with redshift

claims.experiment: MgII-based BH masses compared with luminosity-matched SDSS samples
claims.finding: No convincing evolution in accretion rate

evidence.quote: we do not find convincing evidence for an evolution of quasars accretion rate with redshift

claims.hypothesis: Do near zone sizes evolve steeply with redshift?
